alt: 年輕發明家展示新奇的木製機械，同學驚訝地睜大眼睛。
scene_prompt: A young inventor in a school science room unveils a striking original miniature wooden walking machine on a tabletop, its leaf-shaped mechanisms elegant and unusual. Three classmates react with wide eyes and astonished open mouths, one stepping back in amazement. Emphasize an unexpectedly brilliant innovation that astonishes everyone, not actual exploding rocks or violence.
